description: This file defines the LoraProvider interface for LoRaWAN communication, including methods for message extraction, device identification, and sending commands.

classes.name: LoraProvider
classes.description: Interface for LoRaWAN providers capable of sending and receiving messages with methods for message processing and command transmission.

methods.name: getProviderName
methods.description: Returns the name of the LoRaWAN provider.

methods.name: pathPrefix
methods.description: Returns the URL path prefix used for this provider.

methods.name: extractMessageType
methods.description: Extracts the message type from an incoming JSON message, defaults to UPLINK.

methods.name: acceptedContentType
methods.description: Returns the MIME content type accepted by the provider, default is application/json.

methods.name: acceptedHttpMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method accepted, default is POST.

methods.name: extractDeviceId
methods.description: Extracts device ID from incoming message, may throw exception if malformed.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts payload from incoming message, may throw exception if malformed.

methods.name: extractNormalizedData
methods.description: Extracts normalized data from message, default returns null.

methods.name: extractAdditionalData
methods.description: Extracts additional data from message, default returns null.

methods.name: sendDownlinkCommand
methods.description: Sends a downlink command, default implementation fails with UnsupportedOperationException.
